newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sex symbol Anderson makes deep mark in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Sex symbol Anderson makes deep mark in Belgium.

text.p: Pizza Hut may have bitten off more than it can chew in hiring sex symbol Pamela Anderson Lee to front its new publicity campaign if reactions to her appearance in Belgium on Wednesday are anything to judge by.

Crush barriers were cast aside and the crowd of 300 fans overwhelmed security as the blonde with arguably the most famous cleavage around arrived for a cameo appearance at the company's restaurant in the Brussels suburb of Drogenbos.
There had nearly been a riot earlier when restaurent employees threw the crowd a few T-shirts, posters and postcards bearing the former Baywatch star's picture.
Private security guards and local police had to prop up the crush barriers and order the restaurant staff to stop as the crowd surged forward trying to grab the merchandise.
One wag in the crowd suggested the restaurant chain might rename one of its dishes a "Deep Pam Pizza".
As the black-clad Anderson Lee arrived in a black stretch limousine with smoked windows and police outriders there were screams, cat calls and urgent appeals for her to come closer. She did not.
Instead she turned into the restaurant to face a capacity crowd of reporters all of whom, in order to gain access, had signed a legal undertaking not to ask her about her private life.
Anderson Lee reunited with her husband, Motley Crue drummer Tommy Lee, in December two weeks after filing for divorce.
Her mini tour of Pizza Huts in Europe is also due to take her to Poland, Germany and Spain.
